description: The runner's own control (`tools/runner-control.mjs`), played apart from the cases. `the-call-reader-skips-a-form.json` is refused by point 3 (`control/calls-misread`) for the lines a reader that skips a form reads, and here its `names` keeps those and gains the lines `the-call-reader-reads-the-wrong-line.json` holds under the same rule — the drift a pinned name exists to catch, at the second name of two. Then it is pinned to the shapes the runner refuses before it compares anything: a name that is no list, an empty list, a blank name and a name that is no string, each of the last two beside a good one. Last come two names the refusal holds only with a digit beside them, the words before the first line number and those after the last: a name is found with no digit on either side, so each is a name the message lacks. The runner has to report each.
